::: {#rem-seed-practice}
#### Setting seeds

Set the [seed](#def-seed) once, at the top of the simulation, and record its value with the results.
Different software uses different generators,
so the same seed gives different draws in R and in Python.
Both give correct [simulation estimates](#def-simulation-estimate),
which agree up to their [Monte Carlo standard errors](#def-monte-carlo-standard-error).
:::
